CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

description:
What Success Looks Like In This Role

Provides consultation and hands‑on support to help leaders, teams, and organizations understand, adopt, and implement change initiatives. Supports the design and delivery of change, learning, and end‑user enablement activities that address resistance, improve adoption, and contribute to successful business outcomes. Focuses on the people side of change related to business process updates, systems and technology implementations, job role changes, and organizational adjustments, with an emphasis on end‑user readiness and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides change management, learning, and end‑user enablement support for defined initiatives and projects under the guidance of more senior practitioners.
  • Supports small to moderately complex change or enablement efforts, contributing to project workstreams as assigned.
  • Assists with change impact and readiness assessments to identify stakeholder needs, learning requirements, and end‑user impacts.
  • Helps identify process improvement opportunities by gathering input, documenting current‑state processes, and supporting future‑state recommendations.
  • Contributes to the identification of potential resistance, adoption risks, and capability gaps, and supports the development of mitigation strategies and enablement tactics.
  • Collaborates with change management team members, project teams, and stakeholders to develop and execute deliverables across:
    • Communications and messaging
    • Sponsorship and leadership support
    • Manager and team coaching materials
    • Learning and training content

  • Supports the design and delivery of learning assets (e.g., training sessions, job aids, guides, and performance support materials) that help end users adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Assists in facilitating training sessions, workshops, or enablement activities as needed.
  • Provides support to project teams and people leaders by reinforcing change and adoption practices.
  • Helps track adoption, learning effectiveness, and change progress metrics; documents issues, risks, and feedback.
  • Monitors end‑user feedback and adoption trends, escalating concerns and improvement opportunities to senior team members.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives related to technology, process, or business transformation.
  • Exposure to learning design, training delivery, or end‑user enablement activities.
  • Working knowledge of change management and continuous improvement concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create client‑ready deliverables and presentations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with project teams, stakeholders, and change colleagues globally.
  • Willingness to learn and grow change, learning, and enablement skills through personal development and hands‑on project experiences.

  • Prosci Change Management Practitioner certification, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or related OCM certification is strongly preferred
  • Experience working across global, multi‑cultural environments is strongly preferred.

title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization’s cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization’s digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICs, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third‑party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof‑of‑concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICs).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICs.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

Sobre Nós

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Job Requisition ID: 65247

Department: Human Resources (DEPT_HR)

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

#EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel‑dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock‑management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high‑performance, employee‑centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high‑performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR‑related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Talent Acquisition, development & mobility
    • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
    • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
    • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
    • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high‑performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction and long‑term retention.
  • Performance management & organizational development
    • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management and leadership development strategies.
    • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
    • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data‑driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Dover Fueling Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and affords equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, gender, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, national origin, disability or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, provincial or local law. Dover Fueling Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information or any other factors prohibited by law.

Responsabilidades Da Posição

O(a) Recepcionista será o primeiro ponto de contato dos pacientes e famílias na clínica, sendo responsável por proporcionar uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e humanizada desde o momento da chegada até o término do atendimento. Essa pessoa atuará em um ambiente com grande fluxo de pacientes e atendimentos por diversos planos de saúde, e terá papel essencial na organização do fluxo de agendamentos e documentação da clínica.

  • Receber e acolher pacientes e acompanhantes, oferecendo atendimento cordial e empático;
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de dados no sistema da clínica, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas;
  • Fazer agendamentos, remarcações e confirmações de consultas por telefone, WhatsApp e presencialmente;
  • Orientar sobre documentação, autorizações e guias necessárias para os atendimentos;
  • Conferir guias e autorizações de planos de saúde, encaminhando-as corretamente para o setor de faturamento;
  • Organizar e controlar a agenda dos profissionais, mantendo a comunicação clara entre pacientes e equipe técnica;
  • Apoiar na rotina administrativa da recepção, como controle de presença, emissão de recibos e arquivamento de documentos;
  • Manter o ambiente da recepção organizado e acolhedor, refletindo os valores de cuidado e profissionalismo da clínica.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

  • Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Fisioterapia ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia em recepção de clínica ou hospital, preferencialmente com atendimento a convênios de saúde;
  • Vivência com grande volume de atendimentos e rotina dinâmica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão clínica ou prontuário eletrônico;
  • Domínio básico do pacote Office (principalmente Excel e Outlook);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional e empática;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes, garantindo precisão no preenchimento e conferência de guias;
  • Comprometimento com sigilo e ética profissional, respeitando as informações dos pacientes e os protocolos internos.

Sobre a Empresa

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. Desde 1997, mantém uma sólida parceria com o Jockey Club Brasileiro e, atualmente, está presente em diversas unidades — entre elas, Lagoa, Sociedade Hípica Brasileira e Jacarepaguá. A clínica conta com uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, formada por profissionais de áreas como Fisioterapia, Fonoaudiologia, Terapia Ocupacional, Psicologia, Psicopedagogia e Equoterapia. Todos atuam de forma integrada, com foco em um atendimento humanizado, técnico e ético.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including: Regional Main , Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in person/online meetings, training events. Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded, and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs identify training needs, effectively reach targeted audiences, and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organizations, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet program quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on project outcomes and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access).
  • Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high‑level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public. Knowledge of creating and managing contracts for vendors, data entry, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently to assist in paperwork for processing of grant funds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business or administration and 3-6 years of experience. Five years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Position Overview

POSITION TITLE: Administrative Coordinator
SALARY GRADE: HU-12
JOB CODE: 2404
FLSA STATUS: Exempt
EEO CODE: 05

Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature And Scope

Principal internal contacts generally include administrators, faculty, students and staff. External contacts generally include vendors, consultants, visitors and the general public.

Key Responsibilities

  • Control the workflow of the office. Implement office procedures and practices.
  • Perform directives from supervisor to coordinate administrative procedures within department and/or among other offices.
  • Maintain bookkeeping records of revenues and expenditures for department or school. Assign proper budget codes.
  • Prepare requests for travel authorizations, services request, etc.
  • Check records, meet with staff and resolve any differences with accounting.
  • Supervise the scheduling of appointments, meetings and conferences for department heads and/or other department staff and students.
  • Coordinate logistics of all department events and meetings including travel and lodging arrangements, agendas, information packets, parking, amenities, etc. and provide on‑site guidance to visitors and guests for university related events.
  • Record and maintain agenda and minutes from all division, department and faculty meetings and distribute them accordingly.
  • Review catalogs and order office supplies and equipment. Obtain bids and price quotes from vendors, monitor inventory of supplies.
  • Create and manage office filing systems.
  • Receive, open and screen mail for the department.
  • Assist in the completion of grant proposals for the department and divisions within the department.
  • Process paperwork for the hiring of new salaried personnel, and advise them concerning the University’s procedures.
  • Enter personnel and financial documents with related software applications.
  • Perform data analysis of average difficulty using tables, graphs and basic statistics. Submit final reports to department administrators and/or managers.
  • Perform other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access). Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population. Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business field – Accounting, Finance, Computer information Systems, Cyber Security, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, Management, Economics and 3-6 years of experience.

Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

description:
REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência.

O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência.

Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

PROCESSO SELETIVO

1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:

1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.

1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato; caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.

1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso.

1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.

1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.

1.7.6 O Processo Seletivo será composto de:

  • 1ª ETAPA – Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 2ª ETAPA – Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 3ª ETAPA – Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
  • 4ª ETAPA – Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.

Somente o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado terá direito à contratação.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO

  • Atuar em centro cirúrgico ou CME ou enfermaria cirúrgica pediátrica;
  • Auxiliar a equipe em procedimentos invasivos;
  • Auxiliar em reanimação de paciente;
  • Aprontar paciente para exame e cirurgia;
  • Coletar material para exames;
  • Controlar administração de medicamentos;
  • Auxiliar a equipe cirúrgica durante o ato operatório;
  • Responsável pela organização da sala operatória;
  • Acompanhamento e vigilância de pacientes em SRPA;
  • Realizar a recepção de instrumental cirúrgico em área de limpeza de CME, realizar lavagem de instrumental e preparar pacotes de esterilização de instrumental e organizar o material na área de guarda e dispensação do material para o centro cirúrgico;
  • Realizar acolhimento de pacientes e familiares e verificação de sinais em atendimento ambulatorial;
  • E demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

  • Coren ativo;
  • Total disponibilidade;

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale alimentação ou Refeição;

INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

  • Local de trabalho: Hospital Jesus - Rio de Janeiro;
  • Horário de expediente: 07:00 às 19:00.

description:
Senior Technical Consultant – RJ

The Senior Technical Consultant is ultimately responsible for leading large, complex, customer engagements, and ensuring the technical success of the Global Delivery Services. With a requirement for coaching junior consultants, leading solution designs, troubleshooting, escalation management, and hands‑on delivery, the Senior TC will also work closely with the project manager to ensure project status is communicated, a plan is in place, and progress is being made to achieve project completion.

The role will apply advanced subject matter expertise to complex business issues; working on multifaceted problems/projects where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Within our delivery centers, the role expects a high degree of technical aptitude and attention to detail at all times. They are expected to perform independently and carry out storage, compute, data protection, and other technical activities autonomously. They have a strong understanding of the overall IT infrastructure components, especially storage, compute & data protection technologies and a deep knowledge of ITIL processes & services and can put them into practice as & where needed. They drive customer projects and can provide resolutions to escalated issues & problems.

They’re expected to mentor junior staff and write detailed process documents, work‑instructions, and run‑books.

What you will bring

  • Perform & lead innovative Delivery Services for Hitachi Vantara customers as defined in a Statement of Work.
  • Create detailed technical designs from high level solution designs, based on an analysis of the customer’s environment and requirements.
  • Take strategic decisions in consultation with Service Delivery Manager (SDM) / Project Manager (PM) based on the most relevant factors available that drive effectiveness and value to the customer.
  • Provide technical subject expertise to troubleshoot and identify operational, connectivity and network issues, providing rational business cases and arguments to persuade upwardly and with peers.
  • Assist with the creation of new innovative delivery collateral and maintenance of existing delivery collateral. Recommending improvements in order to increase efficiency, effectiveness and pioneering customer success.
  • Provide analysis and implementation support for SAN/NAS Storage solutions, initial implementation, and integration into the environment as required.
  • Provide input into the creation, establishment and maintenance of IT policies, procedures and practices using ITIL framework to efficiently manage the storage infrastructure.
  • Provide input to the Service Delivery Manager for the monthly governance meetings and reports with the customer and Hitachi.
  • Coach and train technical consultants, whilst also providing guidance to local teams or 3rd party partners, building mutual support, and understanding with colleagues.
  • Supports the SDM & PM in strengthening the relationship with the customer.
  • Identify and provide suggested continuous improvement initiatives within the account.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5+ years technical consultancy and enterprise experience.
  • A minimum of 7+ years technical IT related experience.
  • At least five years’ experience within Hitachi technologies, a similar competitor organization, end user or IT consultancy services provider.
  • A demonstrated problem solver, mentor, coach, and leader who can work independently, is well organized, and always pays close attention to detail.
  • A willingness to work a flexible schedule and to travel is a must for this role.
  • Demonstrate strong presentation skills on technical subjects.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers at all levels.

About us

Championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are integral to our culture and identity. We support your uniqueness and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our team.

description:

O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

  2. Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  3. Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

  5. Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  6. Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  7. Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  8. Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  9. Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação Técnica em Automação;
  • Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial;
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba - SP;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

  • Ensino médio completo, desejável Formação em Logística, Administração ou área relacionada.

description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands-on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys-related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect.
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features.
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

  • Strong background in clinical research methodology, biostatistics, or translational science.

Preferred

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.

  • Influence how AI understands and evaluates real‑world clinical evidence.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.

Application Process (Takes 15–20 min)

title: Senior Compliance Counsel
description:
Senior Compliance Counsel

Department: Legal & Compliance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Compliance Counsel under the guidance of the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 and the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department will provide compliance support and oversight in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and help to ensure that FWWC 2027’s activities comply with applicable compliance laws and regulations and meet best practices.

The FWWC 2027 is seeking an experienced individual to be an integral part of the FWWC 2027 team, responsible for implementing and overseeing a comprehensive governance and compliance programme throughout the organisation.

This person will act as a point of reference in Brazil for compliance‑related matters within FWWC 2027, as well as be the compliance liaison for the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department in Miami.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance

  • Establish a framework to identify, prioritize and enable the effective and efficient management of compliance risks facing the organisation through periodic compliance risk assessment.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Compliance and Risk team in Miami to design, implement and periodically review compliance policies and procedures governing key risk areas such conflicts of interest, anti‑bribery and corruption, anti‑money laundering/KYC, gifts and entertainment, etc.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the compliance programme activities.
  • Provide ad hoc compliance and governance related advice.
  • Design and work with HR and Internal Communications to develop and deliver a compliance awareness and training programme.
  • Liaise with external counsel on compliance matters.
  • If applicable, liaise with regulators and auditors.
  • Perform investigations and advise on whistleblower and hotline case management.
  • Advise on third‑party risk and management, including implementing and overseeing third‑party due diligence processes.
  • Manage conflicts of interest, including any required disclosures associated with such conflicts of interest.
  • Key point of reference for the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 on all compliance matters in Brazil.
  • Act as main compliance delegate for overall FWWC 2027 risk management activities, including timely implementation of compliance risk mitigation plans.

General

  • Demonstrate a team‑based approach to achieving the best outcomes for FWWC 2027 in accordance with FIFA’s values.
  • Ensure productive working relationships with all the relevant stakeholders (FIFA, CBF, Host Cities, stadium authorities, government entities, FIFA’s Commercial Affiliates, multilateral development institutions, NGOs and local communities).
  • Demonstrate an understanding of FWWC 2027’s commercial drivers and desired outcomes, and a willingness to take a hands‑on approach.
  • Manage the escalation process for compliance risks.
  • Drive process efficiency and policy improvement.
  • Ensure the assigned responsibilities are delivered: to a high standard of quality and timeliness; in full compliance with the safety and security rules and requirements of FWWC 2027 and FIFA; and in line with any applicable key performance indicators.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Laws
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil (or the ability to easily obtain this qualification)
  • Fluency in English

Experience

  • A minimum of 4 - 5 years’ experience as a qualified lawyer, with in‑house experience preferred
  • Experience in compliance or a related field.
  • Excellent writing skills
  • Good analytical and organisational skills
  • Experience with sporting or events organisations or commercial rights holders/sponsorship

Other knowledge and skills

  • Experience in MS Office programmes (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams)
  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and follow‑through
  • Capable of balancing legal and commercial outcomes
  • Ability to manage competing priorities
  • Skilled at time management
  • Skilled in problem solving, solution‑oriented and pragmatic
  • Flexibility and a related ability to work autonomously in a dynamic and fast‑paced environment
  • A team player who is skilled at building relationships internally and externally
  • Empathetic, collaborative and patient, with a positive attitude
  • Ability to communicate efficiently in multi‑stakeholder environments
  • Strong identification with the FIFA World Cup and the potential positive impact on the Host Country
  • Passion for football recommended

Requiriments

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.

Who You Are

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands‑on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high‑pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.

Our Culture and Commitment to You

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well‑being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people‑focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

description:
Junte-se ao DOF como nosso próximo Engenheiro de Integridade de Máquinas Offshore?

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Integridade de Máquinas Offshore para fortalecer os processos de manutenção da frota no Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a confiabilidade operacional, segurança das operações e conformidade regulatória das embarcações.

Aqui, você fará parte de uma organização global sólida, com forte cultura de HSEQ, processos estruturados e compromisso com melhoria contínua. Buscamos um profissional analítico, com visão sistêmica e capacidade de transformar dados técnicos em ações que aumentem a eficiência e a integridade dos sistemas de máquinas.

Requirements

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a gestão de integridade dos sistemas de máquinas da frota;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos planos de manutenção das embarcações;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados à manutenção e confiabilidade operacional;
  • Realizar análises de dados aplicadas à gestão de manutenção;
  • Apoiar processos de Root Cause Analysis (RCA) e investigação de falhas;
  • Atuar na adequação dos processos às normas e regulamentações aplicáveis;
  • Garantir atendimento aos requisitos contratuais dos clientes, especialmente no contexto de auditorias;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos técnicos da frota;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da gestão de qualidade e integridade de máquinas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas técnicas e de HSEQ para garantir padronização e segurança operacional.

Formação Acadêmica / Técnica

(Education / Technical Training)

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica ou Engenharia Naval;
  • Registro ativo no conselho profissional competente (CREA).

Habilidades Técnicas

(Technical Skills)

  • Experiência com gestão de sistemas de manutenção aplicados a embarcações;
  • Análise de dados voltada para confiabilidade e manutenção;
  • Elaboração, acompanhamento e análise de KPIs;
  • Técnicas de apresentação e comunicação;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua, como Lean, Six Sigma e Agile ;
  • Capacidade analítica e orientação para solução de problemas.

Experiência

(Experience)

  • Experiência prévia em manutenção, gestão de processos ou gestão da execução de reparos em embarcações offshore;
  • Conhecimento de operações e manobras de movimentação de carga em ambiente offshore;
  • Experiência com investigação de acidentes e análise de falhas;
  • Conhecimento aplicado das Normas Regulamentadoras NR-12 e NR-34 no contexto naval;
  • Vivência com processos de auditoria e conformidade regulatória será considerada diferencial.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de apresentação técnica;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas;
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua;
  • Comprometimento com segurança operacional e qualidade.

Localização

Base Brasil (atuação onshore com interface direta com as operações offshore).

Quem somos

A DOF é uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços marítimos e submarinos integrados para o mercado global de energia offshore. Combinamos expertise, ativos e tecnologia para executar operações integradas submersas e offshore de forma segura e confiável — sempre.

Com uma equipe multinacional de aproximadamente 6.000 pessoas e a maior frota mundial de Embarcações de Apoio à Construção (CSVs) e embarcações de alto padrão de Rebocadores de Manuseio de Âncoras (AHTS), apoiamos nossos parceiros com alcance global, escala e capacidade líder no setor. Nossos centros operacionais e unidades de negócios estão na Noruega, Dinamarca, Reino Unido, EUA, Singapura, Brasil, Argentina, Canadá, Angola e Austrália.

Na DOF, você entra em uma organização global confiável, onde segurança, trabalho em equipe e integridade vêm em primeiro lugar. Oferecemos crescimento na carreira, desenvolvimento contínuo e uma cultura que valoriza inclusão, reconhecimento e conexão.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Digital Analytics - Pleno você vai somar ao time de Marketing Data que tem como objetivo garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e impulsionar decisões de marketing guiadas por insights.

No dia a dia o seu papel será dividido em quatro pilares de atuação:

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)
  • Desenvolvimento de Data Layer e Tags: Projetar, implementar e validar o dataLayer, scripts de coleta de dados e pixels de mídia no Google Tag Manager (GTM), garantindo a captura correta de eventos e interações

Análise e Extração de Dados

  • Extração e Interpretação de Dados: Utilizar SQL no BigQuery para extrair, organizar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados, identificando tendências, oportunidades de otimização e desafios de performance
  • Mensuração de KPIs: Colaborar com os times internos para entender as necessidades de métricas e KPIs (Aquisição, Ativação, Retenção, Receita), garantindo que sejam corretamente mensurados e que os relatórios reflitam a performance real do negócio

Governança e Qualidade de Dados

  • Assegurar a Qualidade: Definir, documentar e aplicar padrões de Governança de Dados, incluindo a criação e manutenção da documentação técnica (Measurement Plan / Dicionário de Métricas)
  • Auditoria e QA: Implementar rotinas de auditoria e Controle de Qualidade (QA), utilizando debuggers e ferramentas de proxy para garantir a precisão e integridade dos dados coletados e dos relatórios
  • Viabilizar AI/ML: Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos dados para construir uma base sólida, viabilizando modelos de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning de alta performance

Gestão de Projetos e Colaboração

  • Gestão Ágil: Organizar, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de tracking e projetos de dados, utilizando princípios de metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para traduzir conceitos técnicos em orientações claras para stakeholders de marketing e tecnologia
  • Perfil Colaborativo: Ser proativo(a) e atuar como um parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das equipes de Negócios e Produto, prosperando em um ambiente dinâmico

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Tecnologia, Estatística ou áreas correlacionadas
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) e forte compreensão do design da camada de dados (dataLayer)
  • Proficiência em SQL e familiaridade com data warehouses (como BigQuery) e modelagem de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear o funil de E-commerce e mensurar o ciclo de vida do cliente
  • Compreensão básica de JavaScript aplicada à implementação de rastreamento web
  • Experiência em rotinas de Controle de Qualidade (QA) e documentação técnica (Measurement Plan)
  • Conhecimento intermediário de ferramentas de Analytics para App (ex.: AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Curiosidade e entusiasmo para explorar o uso de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Machine Learning em análises
  • Colaboração e Proatividade: Possuir um perfil altamente colaborativo, atuando como parceiro estratégico das equipes de Negócios e Produto, e demonstrando proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de análise

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados e automação
  • Conhecimento básico de como funcionam modelos de Machine Learning (atribuição baseada em dados, predição de churn)
  • Experiência com Customer Data Platform (CDP) e integração de dados de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, TikTok, Google Ads) e CRM (Salesforce)
  • Conhecimento de princípios de metodologia ágil

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

São mais de 500 mil anúncios publicados diariamente e 70 milhões de visitas em nossas plataformas (OLX, VivaReal e Zap Imóveis) por mês. Com tecnologia desenvolvida no Brasil, democratizamos o acesso ao comércio para todos, contribuindo positivamente para a economia.

title: User Operations Intern
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a User Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support day‑to‑day user service and quality efforts that directly improve ride safety, platform trust, and user retention across millions of trips; your work will drive measurable reductions in issue resolution time and increase user satisfaction scores. You will join the User Operations team, which focuses on resolving rider and driver concerns, enforcing policy, and optimizing operational workflows to protect user experience and enable scalable, reliable service delivery.

In this role, you'll be...

  • User Segmentation Analysis: Assist in segmenting users based on multi‑dimensional data (e.g., New, Active, Churned) and identifying behavioral patterns and pain points.
  • Execution of Messaging Strategies: Responsible for the configuration and execution of in‑app messages, pop‑ups, H5 and out‑of‑app communication tasks such as push, WhatsApp/SMS, email.
  • Copywriting & Localization: Craft compelling marketing copy for different user segments and optimize localized content to boost Click‑Through Rates (CTR).
  • A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization.
  • Tool Management: Operate internal CMS and automated marketing platforms to ensure precise and timely delivery of messages across all user touchpoints.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational Background: Current undergraduate student, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or Statistics.
  • Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for crafting marketing copy; proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
  • Data Sensitivity: A basic understanding of operational metrics (e.g., CTR, Retention) and proficiency in Excel are required. Proficiency in SQL queries is a plus.
  • Work Ethic: Highly detail‑oriented and responsible. Since messaging tasks impact the entire user base, a high level of accuracy is required.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth.

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion.

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end‑to‑end, and component tests .

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail‑oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional teams.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work‑life balance. Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Compromisso com a Igualdade, Diversidade e Inclusão

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como os serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem-estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. title: Engenheiro(a) de Projetos Topside Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Projetos Sênior para atuar na área de Engenharia Topside em nosso escritório. Sendo responsável por atuar na gestão estratégica do portfólio de projetos da organização. Sua missão será garantir a análise contínua do desempenho dos projetos, avaliando causas e impactos que influenciem seus resultados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável por suportar a avaliação das causas/impactos sobre o desempenho dos projetos;
  • Avaliar o portfólio de projetos, verificando a interdependência, sobreposição de projetos e a distribuição de recursos disponíveis, para otimizar o uso dos recursos e comunicar a diretoria sobre eventuais ajustes no portfólio;
  • Administrar o portfólio, alinhando a estratégia organizacional com os projetos em andamento;
  • Estabelecer processos para priorização, comunicação e balanceamento do portfólio, garantindo o uso otimizado dos recursos;
  • Definir e monitorar os principais indicadores de desempenho, garantindo que eles reflitam os objetivos estratégicos e operacionais da organização;
  • Coordenar a disseminação dos indicadores para as áreas relevantes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória:

  • Habilidade em avaliação de risco de problemas complexos;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente;
  • Capacidade de suportar decisões estratégicas sob pressão;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e boa capacidade de colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.

Qualificações/certificações:

  • Proficiência em Inglês;
  • Conhecimento do sistema SAP será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Como será nosso encontro na PRIO?

Queremos conhecer você melhor e entender como podemos trabalhar juntos, como parte do Time PRIO. Para isso, pedimos que você preencha o teste de fit cultural, durante a etapa de cadastro, para que possamos entender o seu alinhamento com a nossa Cultura :)

Você fará a marcação da sua disponibilidade para a conversa acontecer. A ideia é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências e entender como elas se alinham com a PRIO. Nesse papo, também vamos falar sobre a companhia, nossos benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Durante nossa conversa, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou em sua atual jornada e experiências anteriores, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Faça seu cadastro aqui no sistema, preencha todas as informações de forma completa e vem com a gente construir o futuro do Campo de Peregrino, juntos !

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Ability to be both entrepreneurially minded and collaborative as part of dynamic team

  • Comfort working in a fast paced, high iteration environment

Company Benefits

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
